Name: (AT) DustBeauty's Industrial Furniture
Author: Novaphene
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/7DxaSXe.png[/img]
This is an AT conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/9139916]DustBeauty's[/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5444]Industrial Furniture[/url]. This unofficial mod utilized purely the assets of DustBeauty and did not therefore add any items or variations except for the cribs.

Permissions can be checked [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/9139916]here[/url].


 [img]https://imgur.com/HmfUsq0.png[/img]
[i]Features 100+ alternative textures of furniture! 

[/i][b]version 4.0[/b]
Here's a [url=https://www.canva.com/design/DAGE-Zu-R3c/ZMh5bwLc0An9vc7CViDdVw/view?utm_content=DAGE-Zu-R3c&utm_campaign=designshare&utm_medium=link&utm_source=editor]visual note[/url] of what the fixes were:
[list]
[*]fixed chairs
[*]fixed armchairs
[*]fixed couches
[*]fixed pub tables
[*]fixed stools
[*]fixed benches
[/list][b]version 3.0[/b]
[list]
[*]bonsai tree
[*]wall decorations
[*]rug
[*]collective fireplaces
[*]misc.[spoiler]  [img]https://i.imgur.com/KmzORcx.png[/img]﻿ [/spoiler]
[/list][b]version 1.0[/b]
Features 100+ alternative textures of furniture! 
Categories based on [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Furniture]wiki[/url]:
[list]
[*]beds: single, double, child
[*]benches
[*]chairs
[*]couches & armchairs
[*]tables
[*]long tables 
[*]bookcases & dressers
[*]rugs
[*]lamps & window
[*]TVs
[*]decorative plants
[*]paintings 
[*]movie posters
[*]wall hangings 
[*]fish tanks
[*]misc.
[*]other decorations 
[*]catalogue items
[/list]
[b]
(CP) Baby Crib.[/b] For the cribs, DustBeauty had 2 (cream and brown via the config) in which case, I added more variations (gradient, marble, powder ash, santa grey, zeus)
